article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Be An Archer)
article_summaries.summary: A live-game news post from the official site (captured 2009-11-14) that launches a week-long job spotlight, starting with the Archer job. It explains how to find the Archer trainer Lugabow in Greenwood Forest and lists the trainer NPCs for the Archer, Wizard, Medic, Blacksmith and Warrior jobs. The post gives no exact dates, levels or rewards beyond general descriptions.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Be A Medic)
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post from the week of the Job Sampling event, highlighting the Medic job. It says Medics heal and use special medical equipment such as shock paddles, and that players start Medic training by talking to Nurse Naia outside the Sanctuary hospital. The post says a different job is featured each day that week and lists the trainer NPCs for Archer, Wizard, Medic, Blacksmith and Warrior.

article_summaries.title: Etre Un Médecin (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A French-language official news post, part of a week-long Job Sampling series, introducing the Medic job. It says a Medic heals a group in hard fights and fights with specialized medical gear such as a defibrillator, and that aspiring Medics find trainer Naima, the nurse outside the Sanctuary hospital, who may recommend Medical Training. It also lists the five job trainers and says a different job is featured each day of the event week.
